C0199.title: Tunyan Network Sues Huoyi Network Over App Store Delisting After Rank-Manipulation Campaign for 'Qu Guandan' Game
C0199.summary: Tunyan (Shanghai) Network provided chart-boosting promotion services for Huoyi Network's 'Qu Guandan' game by using the 'Kaopu Trial' app to generate downloads and inflate rankings. After Apple's App Store detected the manipulation and delisted the game, a payment dispute arose and both parties filed mutual lawsuits.
